status: sealed pre-run; limiter-only learning on the declared attacker mix

scope.question: on the declared attacker coupling-gain mix, does limiter-only PPO (scripted launcher fixed) consistently improve clean N over the hold limiter, and how does the improvement depend on route_gain
scope.single_axis_vs_b5: only the attacker axis differs from the closed b5 experiment (same world, roles, hyperparameters)
scope.f3_excluded: the F3 keeper is a hold-limiter-world artifact; using it under c5/learned limiters would mix a capturer distribution shift into the limiter effect (RL2 lesson)
scope.null_is_a_result: P2_NULL combines with b5 into 'limiter shaping value is insensitive to attacker coupling' and shifts focus to docs/104 Track B (docs/117 exit)

attacker_mix.training_sampler: per episode, config index = sha256('p2-mix', train_seed, ep_idx) mod 6 — declared, uniform, independent of the cell schedule

learned.limiter: MAPPO limiter, final mean layer zeroed at t=0, no commit head; finisher frozen scripted clean-fire (b5 lineage)

training.sampler: pilot 70/20/10 row schedule (scheduled_cell) x the declared attacker-mix sampler
training.budget_rationale: 4x the b5 budget to offset the 1/6 per-config exposure of the mix

hyperparameters.note: b5 pre-declared defaults verbatim (NO_SELECTION stands; no candidate is blessed)

evaluation.paired: within each mix config, all arms share identical (seed0, namespace, scenario_id) draws and episode seeds
evaluation.policy: learned arms stochastic with per-episode fixed torch seed

invalid: neutral limiter init verified at t=0
finisher frozen (no PPO params, no log-prob)
gate.positive: per seed: pooled delta N(learned - hold) >= +34 over the 1,680 paired episodes AND delta N >= 0 on both high-coupling configs; AND pooled H_illegal of hold and both learned arms == 0
report_only: crossing counts (saturated in P1a; never gated)

promotion: P2_POSITIVE opens only a separately sealed follow-up (PFSP re-judgment per docs/117 P3). P2_NULL closes the limiter-learning line and moves focus to Track B.
